facts.fact: Punch reports the Presidency began field operations of the National Agro-Productivity System pilot in Jigawa State, using satellite imagery every five days and machine learning to track crops, with five-day monitoring due to start around January 2027.

systems.platform: Ground Truth Analytics with OCP Africa

facts.fact: Punch reports the Presidency's National Agro-Productivity System, an AI platform using machine learning to classify land cover and identify crops on each farm parcel, began a pilot in 59 Jigawa communities in November 2026.
